title: URM kernel recipe
description: A versioned, declarative mapping from a named kernel fragment to a typed URM mixer semantic spec. A kernel recipe declares a component/equation mapping (a fragment), not a complete model graph. It refers only to registered typed operations and parameter transforms; it cannot hide Python callbacks or use an architecture name as an execution switch.

schema_version.description: Recipe document schema version. Loaders must reject other versions.

kind.description: Declares that this document is a kernel fragment, not a complete model graph.

architecture_ids.description: Source architectures this fragment appears in. Provenance only; never an execution switch.

component_scope.description: Which part of a model this fragment covers (e.g. 'attention_core', 'ssm_core').

required_external_stages.description: Typed model-graph stages that must be supplied externally for a complete model (projections, route generation, cache management, MLPs).

spec.description: The typed UnifiedMixerSpec for the equation; keys are the spec field names and enum values are their serialized strings.
